tool_schemas.name: download_instruments_csv
tool_schemas.description: Downloads the latest instruments CSV from the selected source (Groww CDN or an explicit download_url), records the provided ETag when present, and returns download metadata (source, URL used, observed ETag, and whether content changed/was refreshed). If force is false, we perform a conditional fetch when possible and may return a no-change result when the remote content matches the recorded ETag. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when download_url is required for the chosen source or is malformed, NETWORK_ERROR on upstream fetch failures/timeouts, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when rate limits for downloads are hit.

source.description: Where to download the instruments CSV from.

download_url.description: Explicit CSV URL to download (used for manual_upload/unknown sources).

etag.description: Optional ETag to send/record for conditional downloads and change detection.

force.description: If true, re-download even if the content appears unchanged.

tool_schemas.name: search_instruments
tool_schemas.description: Searches the loaded instruments index using the free-text query and/or structured filters and returns a paginated list of matching instruments plus an opaque cursor for the next page when more results are available (pagination is cursor-based; limit bounds the page size). Results are sorted by sort_by/sort_order when provided; if cursor is provided it must be a cursor previously returned by this endpoint for the same query shape. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid enum values, malformed date-time ranges (expiry_from > expiry_to), invalid numeric ranges (strike_price_min > strike_price_max), or an invalid cursor, and NOT_READY when instruments have not been ingested yet.

query.description: Free-text query matched against name, trading_symbol, groww_symbol, isin, and search keywords.

instrument_type.description: Filter by instrument type (e.g., EQ, FUT, OPT, MF, etc., as present in the dataset).

trading_symbol.description: Filter for an exact or near-exact trading symbol.

groww_symbol.description: Filter for an exact or near-exact Groww symbol.

expiry_from.description: Filter instruments with expiry_date on/after this timestamp.

expiry_to.description: Filter instruments with expiry_date on/before this timestamp.

strike_price_min.description: Filter options with strike_price >= this value.

strike_price_max.description: Filter options with strike_price <= this value.

limit.description: Maximum number of instruments to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous search.

tool_schemas.name: get_instrument_details
tool_schemas.description: Fetches and returns the full instrument record for the given trading_symbol, using exchange to disambiguate when the symbol exists on multiple exchanges. If exchange is omitted and the symbol is ambiguous, we refuse the request rather than guessing. Raises NOT_FOUND when no instrument matches the provided identifiers and VALIDATION_ERROR when trading_symbol is empty/invalid or the request is ambiguous without an exchange.

trading_symbol.description: Trading symbol of the instrument to fetch.

exchange.description: Exchange to disambiguate instruments sharing the same trading symbol.

tool_schemas.name: place_order
tool_schemas.description: Places a new order for the specified instrument (by instrument_id or by trading_symbol+exchange) and returns the created order with our internal order_id, the broker groww_order_id when available, and the initial lifecycle status. We validate required fields and type-specific constraints (e.g., price required for LIMIT/SL, trigger_price required for SL/SLM) and treat user_reference_id as an idempotency key for safe retries. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid fields or unsupported combinations, NOT_FOUND when the instrument cannot be resolved, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the trading session is not authorized for order placement, QUOTA_EXCEEDED when order-rate limits are exceeded, and CONFLICT when user_reference_id is reused for a different order payload or when the instrument identity is inconsistent (e.g., instrument_id and trading_symbol resolve to different instruments).

user_reference_id.description: Client-provided reference id used to track the order across retries and lookups.

instrument_id.description: Internal instrument id to place the order for.

trading_symbol.description: Trading symbol to place the order for (used if instrument_id is not provided).

price.description: Limit price (required for LIMIT; used as order price for SL).

disclosed_quantity.description: Disclosed quantity (if supported for the instrument/exchange).

client_timestamp.description: Client-side timestamp for when the order was created/submitted.

tool_schemas.name: modify_order
tool_schemas.description: Modifies an existing order identified by order_id or groww_order_id and returns the updated order snapshot and current lifecycle status. Only orders in a modifiable state (e.g., pending/open and not terminal) can be changed, and we validate that the requested fields are compatible with the original order type (e.g., trigger_price only for SL/SLM; price required for LIMIT/SL when updated). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when no identifier is provided or fields are invalid, NOT_FOUND when the order does not exist, CONFLICT when the order is already filled/cancelled/rejected/expired or otherwise not modifiable, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN/QUOTA_EXCEEDED for authorization and rate-limit enforcement.

groww_order_id.description: Groww broker order id to modify.

order_id.description: Internal order id to modify (alternative to groww_order_id).

client_timestamp.description: Client-side timestamp for when the modification was requested.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_order
tool_schemas.description: Cancels an existing order identified by order_id or groww_order_id and returns the cancelled order snapshot with its resulting lifecycle status. Cancellation is only allowed for cancellable states (typically pending/open); terminal orders cannot be cancelled. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when no identifier is provided, NOT_FOUND when the order does not exist, CONFLICT when the order is already terminal or otherwise not cancellable, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when access or rate limits prevent the cancellation.

groww_order_id.description: Groww broker order id to cancel.

order_id.description: Internal order id to cancel (alternative to groww_order_id).

client_timestamp.description: Client-side timestamp for when the cancel was requested.

tool_schemas.name: get_order_status
tool_schemas.description: Returns the latest known status for the provided groww_order_id, and optionally includes associated trade fills when include_trades is true. This endpoint returns a single order record (not paged) with lifecycle fields and broker identifiers. Raises NOT_FOUND when the groww_order_id is unknown, VALIDATION_ERROR when the id is empty/invalid, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the trading session cannot access the order.

groww_order_id.description: Groww broker order id to fetch status for.

include_trades.description: If true, include associated trade fills if available.

tool_schemas.name: get_order_status_by_reference
tool_schemas.description: Looks up and returns the latest status for the order previously placed with the given user_reference_id, and optionally includes trade fills when include_trades is true. If multiple orders exist with the same reference id due to upstream/broker anomalies, we refuse to guess and require remediation. Raises NOT_FOUND when no order exists for the reference, CONFLICT when the reference maps to more than one order, VALIDATION_ERROR when the reference is empty/invalid, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when access is not permitted.

user_reference_id.description: Client-provided reference id used when placing the order.

include_trades.description: If true, include associated trade fills if available.

tool_schemas.name: get_order_list
tool_schemas.description: Lists orders within the provided time window (from_ts inclusive, to_ts exclusive) and optional filters (status/exchange/product/side/instrument), returning a paginated result set when the number of orders exceeds the server page size. Pagination uses an opaque cursor token returned in the response for fetching subsequent pages, and results are returned in reverse-chronological order by creation time unless otherwise specified by the backend. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed timestamps, from_ts >= to_ts, invalid enum values, or an invalid cursor, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the session cannot access order history, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when history/listing rate limits are exceeded.

from_ts.description: Start timestamp (inclusive) for the day/order window to fetch orders.

to_ts.description: End timestamp (exclusive) for the day/order window to fetch orders.

status.description: Filter orders by internal lifecycle status.

instrument_id.description: Filter orders by internal instrument id.

user_reference_id.description: Filter orders by client-provided reference id.

limit.description: Maximum number of orders to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get_order_details
tool_schemas.description: Get detailed information about a specific order

order_id.description: Internal order id to fetch details for.

groww_order_id.description: Broker/Groww order id to fetch details for.

user_reference_id.description: Client-provided reference id to locate an order.

tool_schemas.name: get_order_trades
tool_schemas.description: Lists all trade/execution records associated with an order identified by order_id (or by groww_order_id when provided), returning results sorted by sort_by/sort_order and paged with limit and an opaque cursor for the next page. Returns an empty page when the order exists but has no executions. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if IDs don’t match required formats or pagination/sort values are invalid, NOT_FOUND if the referenced order cannot be located, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN or RATE_LIMITED when access is not permitted or request quotas are exceeded.

order_id.description: Internal order id to list trades/executions for.

groww_order_id.description: Broker/Groww order id to locate the order whose trades are requested.

limit.description: Maximum number of trades to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of trades.

tool_schemas.name: get_holdings
tool_schemas.description: Returns the user’s current DEMAT holdings snapshot (as of the provided as_of timestamp, otherwise the latest), optionally bypassing cache when refresh is true and storing/reusing results according to ttl_seconds. The response is a single snapshot (not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid as_of or ttl_seconds, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the user session cannot access holdings, and RATE_LIMITED when upstream/broker limits are hit.

as_of.description: Timestamp for which the holdings snapshot is requested (uses latest if omitted).

refresh.description: If true, bypass cache and attempt to fetch a fresh holdings snapshot.

ttl_seconds.description: Cache TTL (in seconds) to apply when storing the snapshot.

tool_schemas.name: get_positions
tool_schemas.description: Returns a snapshot of all open trading positions for the user (as of the provided as_of timestamp, otherwise the latest), optionally bypassing cache when refresh is true and storing/reusing results according to ttl_seconds. The response is a single snapshot list (not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid as_of or ttl_seconds, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the user session cannot access positions, and RATE_LIMITED when upstream/broker limits are hit.

as_of.description: Timestamp for which the positions snapshot is requested (uses latest if omitted).

refresh.description: If true, bypass cache and attempt to fetch fresh positions.

ttl_seconds.description: Cache TTL (in seconds) to apply when storing the snapshot.

tool_schemas.name: get_position_by_symbol
tool_schemas.description: Returns the position matching the given trading_symbol (optionally constrained by exchange) from the positions snapshot at as_of (or the latest), fetching fresh data first when refresh is true. If no matching position exists, returns NOT_FOUND. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid as_of or invalid enum values, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the user session cannot access positions, and RATE_LIMITED when upstream/broker limits are hit.

trading_symbol.description: Trading symbol to fetch a single position for.

as_of.description: Timestamp for which the position is requested (uses latest if omitted).

refresh.description: If true, bypass cache and attempt to fetch fresh positions before filtering.

tool_schemas.name: get_user_margin
tool_schemas.description: Returns the user’s available margin snapshot (as of the provided as_of timestamp, otherwise the latest), optionally bypassing cache when refresh is true and storing/reusing results according to ttl_seconds. The response is a single snapshot (not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid as_of or ttl_seconds, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the user session cannot access margin details, and RATE_LIMITED when upstream/broker limits are hit.

as_of.description: Timestamp for which the margin snapshot is requested (uses latest if omitted).

refresh.description: If true, bypass cache and attempt to fetch a fresh margin snapshot.

ttl_seconds.description: Cache TTL (in seconds) to apply when storing the snapshot.

tool_schemas.name: calculate_margin_requirement
tool_schemas.description: Calculates estimated margin required for one or more order intents and returns the aggregate requirement, optionally including per-order/component breakdown when include_breakdown is true. Each order intent is validated for required fields and pricing rules (e.g., price required for LIMIT/SL; trigger_price required for SL/SLM) and may resolve the instrument by instrument_id or by trading_symbol when instrument_id is omitted. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid fields, unknown instrument resolution, or inconsistent order parameters, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the user session cannot request margin calculations, and RATE_LIMITED when upstream/broker limits are hit.

orders.description: One or more order intents to calculate margin for.

instrument_id.description: Internal instrument id for the margin calculation.

trading_symbol.description: Trading symbol for the margin calculation (used if instrument_id is not provided).

product.description: Product type for the order intent.

order_type.description: Order type for the order intent.

side.description: Buy/sell side for the order intent.

price.description: Limit price for the order intent (required for LIMIT/SL).

trigger_price.description: Trigger price for SL/SLM order types.

include_breakdown.description: If true, return per-order and component-wise margin breakdown if available.

tool_schemas.name: get_live_quote
tool_schemas.description: Returns the full live market quote for the specified instrument_id, using a cached value when use_cache is true and the cached quote age is within max_age_seconds. The response is a single quote (not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if instrument_id format is invalid or max_age_seconds is invalid, NOT_FOUND if the instrument is unknown/unavailable, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN or RATE_LIMITED when access is not permitted or market-data quotas are exceeded.

instrument_id.description: Groww instrument id to fetch the full live quote for.

use_cache.description: Whether to allow returning a cached live quote when available.

max_age_seconds.description: Maximum acceptable cache age in seconds when use_cache is true.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def get_live_quote(instrument_id, use_cache=None, max_age_seconds=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, re, time, hashlib, random
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0344000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0344000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
    now_iso = now.isoformat()

    # No core-collection auditing for this service (per business rules). Do not mutate core collections except cache writes.

    # Validate inputs
    if not isinstance(instrument_id, str) or not re.match(r"^grw_ins_[0-9A-Z]{18,}$", instrument_id):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "instrument_id is invalid; expected pattern ^grw_ins_[0-9A-Z]{18,}$")
    if use_cache is None:
        use_cache = True
    if not isinstance(use_cache, bool):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "use_cache must be a boolean")
    if max_age_seconds is None:
        max_age_seconds = 0
    if not isinstance(max_age_seconds, int) or max_age_seconds < 0:
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "max_age_seconds must be an integer >= 0")

    instruments = _load("instruments.json")
    inst = next((r for r in instruments if isinstance(r, dict) and r.get("id") == instrument_id), None)
    if not inst:
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Instrument not found", instrument_id=instrument_id)
    if inst.get("status") not in ("active", "inactive", "delisted"):
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Instrument unavailable", instrument_id=instrument_id)

    cache = _load("market_data_cache.json")
    # Find best matching cache entry for live_quote: freshest as_of
    candidates = [
        r for r in cache
        if isinstance(r, dict)
        and r.get("instrument_id") == instrument_id
        and r.get("data_type") == "live_quote"
    ]

    def _parse_dt(x):
        if not x or not isinstance(x, str):
            return None
        try:
            return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(x.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
        except Exception:
            return None

    def _is_fresh(row):
        as_of = _parse_dt(row.get("as_of"))
        ttl = row.get("ttl_seconds")
        if as_of is None or not isinstance(ttl, int) or ttl < 0:
            return False
        age = (now - as_of.astimezone(datetime.timezone.utc)).total_seconds()
        if age < 0:
            age = 0
        # Must satisfy both intrinsic TTL and requested max_age_seconds
        return age <= ttl and age <= max_age_seconds and row.get("status") == "fresh"

    if use_cache:
        fresh = [r for r in candidates if _is_fresh(r) and r.get("payload") is not None]
        if fresh:
            fresh.sort(key=lambda r: (_parse_dt(r.get("as_of")) or datetime.datetime(1970, 1, 1, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)), reverse=True)
            best = fresh[0]
            return {
                "instrument_id": instrument_id,
                "data_type": "live_quote",
                "as_of": best.get("as_of"),
                "cached": True,
                "quote": best.get("payload"),
                "cache_id": best.get("id"),
                "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
            }

    # Fetch "upstream" (offline deterministic synthesis) and store new cache entry
    # TTL for live quote cache: short-lived
    ttl_seconds = 2

    base_seed = hashlib.sha256((instrument_id + "|" + (inst.get("trading_symbol") or "")).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    # stable-ish base price then small time-based variation
    base = (int(base_seed[:8], 16) % 5000) + 10  # 10..5009
    wobble = (int(now.timestamp()) % 17) - 8
    ltp = round(float(base) + float(wobble) * 0.25, 2)
    if ltp <= 0:
        ltp = 1.0

    day_open = round(ltp * (0.99 + ((int(base_seed[8:10], 16) % 30) / 10000.0)), 2)
    day_high = round(max(ltp, day_open) * (1.0 + ((int(base_seed[10:12], 16) % 40) / 10000.0)), 2)
    day_low = round(min(ltp, day_open) * (1.0 - ((int(base_seed[12:14], 16) % 40) / 10000.0)), 2)
    prev_close = round(day_open * (0.995 + ((int(base_seed[14:16], 16) % 20) / 10000.0)), 2)
    change = round(ltp - prev_close, 2)
    change_pct = round((change / prev_close) * 100.0, 4) if prev_close else None

    quote = {
        "instrument_id": instrument_id,
        "trading_symbol": inst.get("trading_symbol"),
        "exchange": inst.get("exchange"),
        "ltp": ltp,
        "ohlc": {"open": day_open, "high": day_high, "low": day_low, "close": prev_close},
        "change": change,
        "change_percent": change_pct,
        "as_of": now_iso,
        "source": "simulated_upstream",
    }

    # Create cache row; enforce cache schema constraints minimally
    new_id = "grw_mdc_" + hashlib.sha256((instrument_id + "|live_quote|" + now_iso).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:24].upper()
    row = {
        "id": new_id,
        "instrument_id": instrument_id,
        "data_type": "live_quote",
        "timeframe": None,
        "from_ts": None,
        "to_ts": None,
        "max_points": None,
        "derived_from_cache_id": None,
        "algorithm": None,
        "parameters": None,
        "as_of": now_iso,
        "ttl_seconds": ttl_seconds,
        "status": "fresh",
        "payload": quote,
        "error_message": None,
        "created_at": now_iso,
        "updated_at": now_iso,
    }
    cache.append(row)
    _save("market_data_cache.json", cache)

    return {
        "instrument_id": instrument_id,
        "data_type": "live_quote",
        "as_of": now_iso,
        "cached": False,
        "quote": quote,
        "cache_id": new_id,
        "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
    }

tool_schemas.name: get_ltp
tool_schemas.description: Returns last traded price (LTP) for up to 50 instrument_ids in a single response, using cached values when use_cache is true and each cached entry is within max_age_seconds. The response is not paged; all requested instruments are returned together when possible. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the list is empty/over 50, any instrument_id is malformed, or max_age_seconds is invalid; NOT_FOUND if one or more instruments are unknown/unavailable; and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN or RATE_LIMITED when access is not permitted or market-data quotas are exceeded.

instrument_ids.description: List of up to 50 Groww instrument ids to fetch LTP for.

use_cache.description: Whether to allow returning cached LTP values when available.

max_age_seconds.description: Maximum acceptable cache age in seconds when use_cache is true.

tool_schemas.name: get_ohlc
tool_schemas.description: Returns OHLC data for up to 50 instrument_ids in a single response, using cached values when use_cache is true and each cached entry is within max_age_seconds. The response is not paged; all requested instruments are returned together when possible. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the list is empty/over 50, any instrument_id is malformed, or max_age_seconds is invalid; NOT_FOUND if one or more instruments are unknown/unavailable; and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN or RATE_LIMITED when access is not permitted or market-data quotas are exceeded.

instrument_ids.description: List of up to 50 Groww instrument ids to fetch OHLC for.

use_cache.description: Whether to allow returning cached OHLC values when available.

max_age_seconds.description: Maximum acceptable cache age in seconds when use_cache is true.

tool_schemas.name: get_current_date
tool_schemas.description: Returns the server’s current date/time, optionally converted to the provided IANA timezone, for use when forming historical-data requests. The response is a single value (not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when timezone is not a valid/recognized IANA timezone identifier, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to access the service.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name to return the current date/time in (defaults server timezone if omitted).

tool_schemas.name: get_historical_data
tool_schemas.description: Get historical candle data for an instrument. CONSTRAINTS: 1min(3days,3mo), 5min(15days,3mo), 10min(30days,3mo), 1hr(150days,3mo), 4hr(365days,3mo), daily(1080days,unlimited), weekly(unlimited,unlimited)

instrument_id.description: Groww instrument id to fetch historical candles for.

from_ts.description: Inclusive start timestamp (ISO 8601) for candle data.

to_ts.description: Exclusive end timestamp (ISO 8601) for candle data.

max_points.description: Maximum number of candles to return (may be used to cap large ranges).

use_cache.description: Whether to allow returning cached candle data when available.

max_age_seconds.description: Maximum acceptable cache age in seconds when use_cache is true.

tool_schemas.name: calculate_moving_averages
tool_schemas.description: Computes SMA and EMA series for the requested Groww instrument over candles for the given timeframe and optional [from_ts, to_ts) window, using the selected price_field, and returns the indicator values aligned to candle timestamps (a cached result may be returned when use_cache is true and max_age_seconds is satisfied). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when instrument_id/timeframe/periods/price_field are invalid, periods are < 1, max_age_seconds is < 0, or from_ts/to_ts are not valid ISO-8601 or define an invalid range; raises NOT_FOUND when the instrument_id is unknown or candle data for the instrument/timeframe window cannot be retrieved. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks access to market-data/analytics features, and RATE_LIMITED when indicator/market-data quota is exceeded.

instrument_id.description: Groww instrument id to compute moving averages for.

timeframe.description: Candle timeframe used as the input series.

from_ts.description: Inclusive start timestamp (ISO 8601) for the input candle series.

to_ts.description: Exclusive end timestamp (ISO 8601) for the input candle series.

sma_period.description: Lookback period for Simple Moving Average (SMA).

ema_period.description: Lookback period for Exponential Moving Average (EMA).

price_field.description: Which candle field to use as the price series.

use_cache.description: Whether to allow returning a cached indicator result when available.

max_age_seconds.description: Maximum acceptable cache age in seconds when use_cache is true.

tool_schemas.name: calculate_rsi
tool_schemas.description: Calculates an RSI series for the requested instrument and timeframe over the optional [from_ts, to_ts) candle window using the chosen price_field, returning RSI values aligned to candle timestamps (optionally served from cache when use_cache is true and not older than max_age_seconds). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when instrument_id/timeframe/price_field are invalid, period < 1, max_age_seconds < 0, or timestamps are malformed or define an invalid range; raises NOT_FOUND when the instrument does not exist or the required candles are unavailable. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when analytics access is not permitted, and RATE_LIMITED when computation or upstream market-data limits are hit.

instrument_id.description: Groww instrument id to compute RSI for.

timeframe.description: Candle timeframe used as the input series.

from_ts.description: Inclusive start timestamp (ISO 8601) for the input candle series.

to_ts.description: Exclusive end timestamp (ISO 8601) for the input candle series.

price_field.description: Which candle field to use as the price series.

use_cache.description: Whether to allow returning a cached indicator result when available.

max_age_seconds.description: Maximum acceptable cache age in seconds when use_cache is true.

tool_schemas.name: calculate_bollinger_bands
tool_schemas.description: Computes Bollinger Bands (middle SMA, upper, lower) for the requested instrument/timeframe over the optional [from_ts, to_ts) candle window using the selected price_field, returning band values aligned to candle timestamps (may return a cached computation when use_cache is true and within max_age_seconds). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when instrument_id/timeframe/price_field are invalid, period < 1, stddev_multiplier < 0, max_age_seconds < 0, or timestamps are malformed or define an invalid range; raises NOT_FOUND when the instrument is unknown or candle history cannot be retrieved for the window. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing analytics permissions and RATE_LIMITED when request or market-data quota is exceeded.

instrument_id.description: Groww instrument id to compute Bollinger Bands for.

timeframe.description: Candle timeframe used as the input series.

from_ts.description: Inclusive start timestamp (ISO 8601) for the input candle series.

to_ts.description: Exclusive end timestamp (ISO 8601) for the input candle series.

period.description: Lookback period for the middle band (SMA).

stddev_multiplier.description: Standard deviation multiplier for upper/lower bands.

price_field.description: Which candle field to use as the price series.

use_cache.description: Whether to allow returning a cached indicator result when available.

max_age_seconds.description: Maximum acceptable cache age in seconds when use_cache is true.

tool_schemas.name: calculate_support_resistance
tool_schemas.description: Detects support and resistance levels from historical candles for the given instrument and timeframe within the optional inclusive [from_ts, to_ts] window (backend may cap candles to max_points) and returns the identified levels according to method, lookback, min_touches, and merge_threshold_pct. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when instrument_id/timeframe/method are invalid, max_points < 10, lookback < 2, min_touches < 1, merge_threshold_pct < 0, or timestamps are malformed or define an invalid range; raises NOT_FOUND when the instrument does not exist or candle data for the requested window/timeframe is unavailable. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller is not allowed to run analytics, and RATE_LIMITED when computation or upstream market-data limits are exceeded.

instrument_id.description: Groww instrument id to compute support/resistance for.

timeframe.description: Candle timeframe used for the calculation.

from_ts.description: Start timestamp (inclusive) for historical candles window.

to_ts.description: End timestamp (inclusive) for historical candles window.

max_points.description: Maximum number of candles to use (backend may truncate to this many).

method.description: Algorithm family used to detect levels from highs/lows.

lookback.description: Lookback window (in candles) used by the chosen method.

min_touches.description: Minimum number of touches required to confirm a level.

merge_threshold_pct.description: Percent threshold for merging nearby levels into one.

tool_schemas.name: calculate_volatility_metrics
tool_schemas.description: Computes the requested volatility metrics for an instrument/timeframe over the optional inclusive [from_ts, to_ts] candle window (backend may cap candles to max_points), returning the selected metric outputs (and annualized values when annualize is true where applicable). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when instrument_id/timeframe are invalid, metrics is empty or contains unsupported values, max_points < 10, window < 2, or timestamps are malformed or define an invalid range; raises NOT_FOUND when the instrument is unknown or the candle series cannot be retrieved. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing access to analytics/market data and RATE_LIMITED when metric computation or market-data quotas are exceeded.

instrument_id.description: Groww instrument id to compute volatility metrics for.

timeframe.description: Candle timeframe used for the calculation.

from_ts.description: Start timestamp (inclusive) for historical candles window.

to_ts.description: End timestamp (inclusive) for historical candles window.

max_points.description: Maximum number of candles to use (backend may truncate to this many).

window.description: Rolling window length (in candles) for windowed metrics.

annualize.description: Whether to annualize return-based volatility estimates.

tool_schemas.name: calculate_macd
tool_schemas.description: Calculates MACD for the requested instrument/timeframe over the optional inclusive [from_ts, to_ts] window (backend may cap candles to max_points), returning MACD line, signal line, and histogram aligned to candle timestamps using the specified price_field source. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when instrument_id/timeframe/price_field are invalid, fast_period < 1, slow_period < 2, signal_period < 1, fast_period >= slow_period, max_points < 10, or timestamps are malformed or define an invalid range; raises NOT_FOUND when the instrument does not exist or candles for the window/timeframe cannot be retrieved. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when analytics access is not granted and RATE_LIMITED when computation or market-data quotas are exceeded.

instrument_id.description: Groww instrument id to compute MACD for.

timeframe.description: Candle timeframe used for the calculation.

from_ts.description: Start timestamp (inclusive) for historical candles window.

to_ts.description: End timestamp (inclusive) for historical candles window.

max_points.description: Maximum number of candles to use (backend may truncate to this many).

signal_period.description: Signal line EMA period applied to MACD line.

price_field.description: Price source used to compute EMA inputs.

tool_schemas.name: calculate_stochastic
tool_schemas.description: Calculates the Stochastic Oscillator for the requested instrument and timeframe over the specified historical candle window (optionally bounded by from_ts/to_ts), returning %K and %D values aligned to candle timestamps. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when instrument_id/timeframe are invalid or when any oscillator periods/smoothing parameters are out of range per the schema, or when timestamps are malformed or define an invalid range; raises NOT_FOUND when the instrument is unknown or candle history is unavailable for the timeframe/window. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks analytics permissions and RATE_LIMITED when computation or market-data quotas are exceeded.

instrument_id.description: Groww instrument id to compute Stochastic Oscillator for.

timeframe.description: Candle timeframe used for the calculation.

from_ts.description: Start timestamp (inclusive) for historical candles window.

to_ts.description: End timestamp (inclusive) for historical candles window.

max_points.description: Maximum number of candles to use (backend may truncate to this many).

d_period.description: Moving average period for %D signal line.

ma_type.description: Moving average type used for smoothing and %D.

tool_schemas.name: calculate_williams_r
tool_schemas.description: Calculate Williams %R for momentum analysis

instrument_id.description: Groww instrument id to compute Williams %R for.

timeframe.description: Candle timeframe used for the calculation.

from_ts.description: Start timestamp (inclusive) for historical candles window.

to_ts.description: End timestamp (inclusive) for historical candles window.

max_points.description: Maximum number of candles to use (backend may truncate to this many).

tool_schemas.name: calculate_adx
tool_schemas.description: Calculate ADX (Average Directional Index) for trend strength analysis

instrument_id.description: Groww instrument id to compute ADX for.

timeframe.description: Candle timeframe used for the calculation.

from_ts.description: Start timestamp (inclusive) for historical candles window.

to_ts.description: End timestamp (inclusive) for historical candles window.

max_points.description: Maximum number of candles to use (backend may truncate to this many).

tool_schemas.name: calculate_fibonacci_levels
tool_schemas.description: Calculate Fibonacci retracement and extension levels for support/resistance analysis

instrument_id.description: Groww instrument id to compute Fibonacci levels for.

timeframe.description: Candle timeframe used for the calculation.

from_ts.description: Start timestamp (inclusive) for historical candles window.

to_ts.description: End timestamp (inclusive) for historical candles window.

max_points.description: Maximum number of candles to use (backend may truncate to this many).

swing.description: How to choose the swing high/low used for Fibonacci computation.

include_extensions.description: Whether to also compute extension levels beyond the swing.

extension_levels.description: Extension ratios to compute when include_extensions is true (e.g., 1.272, 1.618, 2.0).

tool_schemas.name: analyze_candlestick_patterns
tool_schemas.description: Scans historical OHLC candles for the given Groww instrument and timeframe within the optional [from_ts,to_ts] window (bounded by max_points) and returns the detected candlestick patterns filtered by the requested patterns set and min_confidence. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when instrument_id does not match the Groww id format, timeframe/patterns are not supported, max_points < 5, min_confidence is outside [0,1], or from_ts/to_ts are invalid or from_ts > to_ts. Raises NOT_FOUND when the instrument_id is unknown or no candle series exists for the requested timeframe/window, and raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks access to market-data/analysis features or is rate-limited (QUOTA_EXCEEDED).

instrument_id.description: Groww instrument id to analyze candlestick patterns for.

timeframe.description: Candle timeframe used for the analysis.

from_ts.description: Start timestamp (inclusive) for historical candles window.

to_ts.description: End timestamp (inclusive) for historical candles window.

max_points.description: Maximum number of candles to scan for patterns.

patterns.description: Subset of patterns to detect; if omitted backend detects common defaults.

min_confidence.description: Minimum confidence score threshold for returning a detected pattern.

tool_schemas.name: get_instrument_import_job
tool_schemas.description: Fetches and returns a single instrument import job by id. Refuses when the job id does not exist or the caller is not permitted to view import job metadata.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_instrument_import_job
tool_schemas.description: Cancels an in-flight instrument import job by id by transitioning its status to cancelled. Refuses if the job is already in a terminal state (completed/failed/cancelled) or if the transition is not allowed from the current status.

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason for cancellation (stored as error_message when applicable).

tool_schemas.name: get_auth_context
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity and authorization context used by this MCP server, including the active credential type, granted scopes, and current rate-limit/quota consumption when available. Refuses when the request is unauthenticated or the credential is invalid/expired.

include_rate_limits.description: If true, include current rate-limit/quota consumption and reset timestamps when available.
